evidence_scope: Bullet rigid-body flight with four motors; uncalibrated simulated vehicle; sampled mission safety
task_policy: highest priority first; nearest announced task after current task; no preemption for equal priority

survivor_metrics.note: Separate mission-continuity measure; never replaces strict all-UAV landing/completion.

reconfiguration_efficiency_definition: measured completed relay handoffs / dispatched replacements; null if no dispatch

parameters.collision_envelope: sphere; radius=body_radius_m; infinite ground at z=0
parameters.command_limit_scope: velocity/tilt/rate request limits; external forces can exceed them
parameters.scope: uncalibrated 6DOF rigid-body model; not physical-airframe qualification

physics.energy_model: Declared 1200 s endurance and scenario recharge; not physical battery calibration
physics.camera_model: Ideal world-down stabilized RGB at measured COM position

qualification: Development physics run; not the original kinematic qualification or hardware evidence
